sn56.96-101:1.1: la || || Evam eva kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye chedana-vadha-bandhana-viparāmosa-ālopa-sāhasākārā pativiratā || atha kho ete va bahutarā sattā ye bhedana-vadhabandhana-viparāmosa-ālopa-sāhasākārā appaṭiviratā || || Taṃ kissa hetu || || Adiṭṭhattā bhikkhave catunnam ariyasaccānaṃ || katamesaṃ catunnaṃ || || Dukkhassa ariyasaccassa || la || dukkhanirodhagāminiyā patipadāya ariyasaccassa || ||
sn56.96-101:2.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave Idaṃ dukkhan ti yogo karaṇīyo || la || Ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yogo karaṇīyo ti || || Atha kho Bhagavā
